ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:10; dominant low-intensity (dark) pigmentation across the majority of the surface with localized high-intensity (white) pixels in linear streaks and clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region across central and lower fluke lobes; high-contrast white linear streaks (rakes) distributed across mid-lobe regions; high-intensity focal spots concentrated on the terminal tips and intermittently along the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal pixel angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with multiple irregular nicks and jagged peaks; highest density of indentations observed on the inner-half of the trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoid-shaped curve characterized by a convex sweep from the median notch transitioning into a concave curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular high-contrast clusters visible on the outermost terminal tips of both lobes, consistent with calcified growth or barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) varying in length, primarily oriented diagonally across the ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular jagged nicks along the trailing edge and calcified clusters on the distal tips.
